governingStatute: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (Act No. 12 of 2017)
title: Tax deduction at source under Goods and Services Tax
plainTextSummary: Departments or establishments of the Central Government or State Government, local authorities, governmental agencies, and specified PSUs must deduct tax at source at the rate of 2% (1% CGST + 1% SGST or 2% IGST) from payment made or credited to the supplier where the total value of supply under a contract exceeds ₹2,50,000 (excluding GST). No deduction is made if the location of supplier and place of supply are in a different State/UT from the State/UT of registration of the recipient.

keyStatutoryThresholds.depositDeadline: 10th day of the following month in Form GSTR-7
keyStatutoryThresholds.tdsCertificateForm: Form GSTR-7A generated on common portal within 5 days of crediting amount to Government
